Tired of the same old highway view? As a Truck Driver for De Klok Dranken in Helmond, your route is the ultimate Dutch hospitality tour! 🚛 You'll be the VIP who delivers the drinks to the coolest bars, trendiest restaurants, and biggest events in the Netherlands. 🏟️ Not only is it an awesome gig, but you'll also earn a great hourly rate—between €17 and €19—in a long-term role. Ready to drive the good times? Read on.

What we offer
- Hourly wage between €17 and €19 per hour
- Drive in nice and modern trucks
- Travel allowance from €0,23 each kilometer
- Development opportunities
- Starting in the morning, home in the evening
- Guaranteed working hours

Who you are
As a truck driver C, you are customer-friendly and service-oriented. You are not afraid to perform physical work and you enjoy having a chat with customers. You also have the requirements below:

- You possess a C driving license, Code 95, and a driver's card
- You can speak English
- You are a customer and service-oriented driver

What will you do
You arrive at De Klok Dranken in the morning for another varied day. You're looking forward to it! You grab a cup of coffee with your colleagues and check the route planning for the day. That’s a calm start. ☕
The schedule includes restaurants, cinemas, and events—in short: Hospitality in all shapes and sizes. It's busy, but you're not worried! You'll handle everything today, with or without a co-driver, depending on the route. Happy customers. Happy team. Happy you! 😁
Your working days are usually Monday through Friday, and you work in day shifts with times ranging from 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM or 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM. Working on a Saturday may occasionally occur, but this is sporadic. In short… a perfect job in combination with your social life. 📴

Where will you work
De Klok Dranken in Helmond is known for its assortment of beers, wines, and soft drinks. It is a dynamic company where teamwork is paramount. Together, you work towards providing the best service ever
